conflicts.permit: We may provide usage information including your personal details to marketing agencies to deliver online advertising on websites or social networks.
conflicts.prohibit: We may provide usage information (but not your personal details) to other websites so that they know that you have visited our websites (see ’How we use cookies and other methods for the collection of website usage data' above).
conflicts.situation: Sharing a user's website usage information with a marketing agency or partner that operates a website/social network to deliver online advertising.
conflicts.reason: One sentence explicitly allows providing personal details alongside usage information to marketing agencies, while the other strictly excludes personal details when providing usage information to other websites.
